question: Could you walk me through how to calculate the rupee difference between the mean and the median contract value for all the completed works under the client for Tanvir Menon's Six Sigma Black Belt assignment on the Rajasthan Pkg-58 water treatment plant, and make sure the final number is negative if the mean is lower?
cypher:
MATCH (p:Person {name: "Tanvir Menon"})-[:HOLDS]->(c:Credential {kind: "Six Sigma Black Belt"})
MATCH (w:Work {title: "Rajasthan Pkg-58 water treatment plant"})-[:FOR_CLIENT]->(client)
WHERE w.state = "completed"
MATCH (contract:Contract)-[:FOR_CLIENT]->(client)
WITH collect(toInteger(contract.awarded_value)) AS contractValues
WITH contractValues,
  (CASE 
    WHEN size(contractValues) = 0 THEN 0
    ELSE (reduce(total = 0, val IN contractValues | total + val) / toFloat(size(contractValues))) 
  END) AS meanValue,
  (CASE 
    WHEN size(contractValues) = 0 THEN 0
    WHEN size(contractValues) % 2 = 1 THEN contractValues[size(contractValues) / 2]
    ELSE (contractValues[size(contractValues) / 2 - 1] + contractValues[size(contractValues) / 2]) / 2.0
  END) AS medianValue
RETURN meanValue - medianValue AS difference

WITH collect(work.value) AS values
WITH values, 
  toFloat(reduce(s = 0, v IN values | s + v)) / size(values) AS mean,
